text: Evaluate the following fully specified n-i-p perovskite solar cell: glass/FTO/SnO2/perovskite/Spiro-OMeTAD/Au. The perovskite has a bandgap of 1.55 eV and thickness of 600 nm. The SnO2 ETL has an electron mobility of 20 cm2/Vs and work function of 4.2 eV. The Spiro-OMeTAD HTL has a hole mobility of 2 cm2/Vs and work function of 5.2 eV. Estimate the device PCE and explain the dominant factors controlling its performance. Then perform a what-if analysis to determine how the PCE changes when the perovskite thickness, HTL work function, and carrier mobilities are varied within physically reasonable ranges. Compare the model-derived trends with relevant literature evidence.

ASK ml: Evaluate fully specified n-i-p cell glass/FTO/SnO2/perovskite/Spiro-OMeTAD/Au where perovskite bandgap 1.55 eV thickness 600 nm, SnO2 ETL electron mobility 20 cm2/Vs work function 4.2 eV, Spiro-OMeTAD HTL hole mobility 2 cm2/Vs work function 5.2 eV. Run trained PCE model to predict PCE with uncertainty, provide SHAP/feature-importance explanation of dominant factors controlling performance, and perform what-if sweeps varying perovskite thickness (e.g. 200-1000 nm), HTL work function (e.g. 5.0-5.4 eV), ETL electron mobility and HTL hole mobility within physically reasonable ranges. Report predicted PCE values, trends, and optimisation direction.

ASK scaps: Read and run SCAPS-1D for fully specified n-i-p cell glass/FTO/SnO2/perovskite/Spiro-OMeTAD/Au with perovskite bandgap 1.55 eV thickness 600 nm, SnO2 ETL electron mobility 20 cm2/Vs work function 4.2 eV, Spiro-OMeTAD HTL hole mobility 2 cm2/Vs work function 5.2 eV. Return Voc, Jsc, FF and PCE from the solver for the baseline device and explain dominant physical factors. Then perform what-if analysis varying perovskite thickness, HTL work function, and ETL/HTL carrier mobilities within physically reasonable ranges, setting layer properties explicitly. Report quantitative trends for Voc, Jsc, FF, PCE vs each parameter.

ASK literature: For n-i-p perovskite cells using SnO2 ETL and Spiro-OMeTAD HTL with ~1.55 eV perovskite, find what the papers in the collection say about (1) effect of perovskite absorber thickness on PCE/Jsc/Voc, (2) effect of Spiro-OMeTAD HTL work function/energy alignment and doping on performance, (3) effect of ETL/HTL carrier mobilities on charge extraction and PCE. Report with DOIs and short verbatim quotes. Never state anything about a paper not read in a passage.
